title: Mobile race control
trustedLan: Use only on a trusted LAN or with HTTPS. This is not a safety-rated emergency stop.
notConfigured: Mobile race control has not been set up yet.
linkWarning: Anyone with a link may request chaos for that driver. Do not share publicly. Valid for six hours and only while the assignment remains unchanged.
copyLink: Copied if clipboard is available. Otherwise select and copy this link. On other devices use the LAN IP instead of localhost.
setupHere: You are on the race PC. One click generates a strong director credential and saves it on the server. No terminal or restart needed.
setupOnRacePc: Initial setup is only available directly on the race PC. Open http://localhost:5173/display/control (development) or http://localhost:3001/display/control there, then refresh this page.
setupSecretHint: Copy this key now and store it securely. You need it to unlock control on a phone. It is saved on the server in packages/backend/.env and will not be shown here again.
vscWarning: The CU receives speed commands; verify physical behavior. Not an emergency stop.
